```{r}
# Data
mapping <- data.frame(
  sample = c("SRR11647648", "SRR11647649", "SRR11647658", "SRR11647659"),
  mapping_rate = c(83.72, 83.67, 83.04, 83.48),
  duplication_rate = c(6.7, 13.7, 6.5, 10.2)
)

sample_colors <- c(
  "SRR11647648" = "#e89eb8",
  "SRR11647649" = "#332932",
  "SRR11647658" = "#bb9999",
  "SRR11647659" = "#bcbd22"
)

p1 <- ggplot(mapping, aes(x=sample, y=mapping_rate, fill=sample)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label=paste0(round(mapping_rate, 2), "%")), vjust=-0.5, size=4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=sample_colors) +
  ylim(0, 100) +
  labs(title="Mapping Rate per Sample", x="Sample", y="Mapping Rate (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1),
    legend.position = 'none')


p2 <- ggplot(mapping, aes(x=sample, y=duplication_rate, fill=sample)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label=paste0(round(duplication_rate, 2), "%")), vjust=-0.5, size=4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=sample_colors) +
  ylim(0, 100) +
  labs(title="Duplication Rate per Sample", x="Sample", y="Duplication Rate (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1),
    legend.position = 'none')

p1 + p2

ggsave("mapping_duplication.png", width=14, height=6)
```

```{r}
library(rsvg); library(png); library(grid); library(gridExtra)

setwd('C:/Users/avgus/Desktop/data_omics/HW2/mbias_20chr')

files <- list.files(pattern="\\.svg$", full.names=TRUE)
for(f in files){ rsvg::rsvg_png(f, file=gsub(".svg", ".png", f)) }

# Load in order: OT and OB per sample
imgs <- lapply(c(
  "./SRR11647648_mbias_20chr_OT.png", "./SRR11647648_mbias_20chr_OB.png",
  "./SRR11647649_mbias_20chr_OT.png", "./SRR11647649_mbias_20chr_OB.png",
  "./SRR11647658_mbias_20chr_OT.png", "./SRR11647658_mbias_20chr_OB.png",
  "./SRR11647659_mbias_20chr_OT.png", "./SRR11647659_mbias_20chr_OB.png"
), readPNG)

png("combined_mbias_v1.png", width=2400, height=3200)
grid.arrange(grobs=lapply(imgs, rasterGrob), ncol=2,
  top="M-bias plots (OT=left, OB=right)")
dev.off()

grobs_labeled <- lapply(seq_along(imgs), function(i){
  sample_names <- rep(c("SRR11647648","SRR11647649","SRR11647658","SRR11647659"), each=2)
  strand_names <- rep(c("OT","OB"), 4)
  arrangeGrob(rasterGrob(imgs[[i]]), 
              top=paste(sample_names[i], strand_names[i]))
})

png("combined_mbias_v2.png", width=2400, height=3200)
grid.arrange(grobs=grobs_labeled, ncol=2)
dev.off()
```



methylation based

```{r}
# ============================================================
# WGBS Analysis - Data QC and Statistical Analysis
# ============================================================

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)
library(dplyr)

setwd('C:/Users/avgus/Desktop/data_omics/HW2/methylation_chr20')

sample_colors <- c(
  "SRR11647648" = "#e89eb8",
  "SRR11647649" = "#332932",
  "SRR11647658" = "#bb9999",
  "SRR11647659" = "#bcbd22"
)

# ============================================================
# 1. LOAD DATA
# ============================================================
read_bedgraph <- function(file){
  df <- fread(file, skip=1, col.names=c("chr", "start", "end", "methylation", "M", "U"))
  df$coverage <- df$M + df$U
  return(df)
}

s1 <- read_bedgraph("SRR11647648_methylation_CpG.bedGraph")
s2 <- read_bedgraph("SRR11647649_methylation_CpG.bedGraph")
s3 <- read_bedgraph("SRR11647658_methylation_CpG.bedGraph")
s4 <- read_bedgraph("SRR11647659_methylation_CpG.bedGraph")

# ============================================================
# 2. COVERAGE QC
# ============================================================

# Total reads and covered CpGs
cat("Total reads per sample:\n")
cat("SRR11647648:", sum(s1$coverage), "\n")
cat("SRR11647649:", sum(s2$coverage), "\n")
cat("SRR11647658:", sum(s3$coverage), "\n")
cat("SRR11647659:", sum(s4$coverage), "\n")

cat("\nCovered CpGs per sample:\n")
cat("SRR11647648:", nrow(s1), "\n")
cat("SRR11647649:", nrow(s2), "\n")
cat("SRR11647658:", nrow(s3), "\n")
cat("SRR11647659:", nrow(s4), "\n")

# Coverage summary table
coverage_summary <- data.frame(
  sample = c("SRR11647648", "SRR11647649", "SRR11647658", "SRR11647659"),
  total_reads = c(sum(s1$coverage), sum(s2$coverage), sum(s3$coverage), sum(s4$coverage)),
  covered_CpGs = c(nrow(s1), nrow(s2), nrow(s3), nrow(s4))
)
print(coverage_summary)

# Coverage distribution plot
s1$sample <- "SRR11647648"; s2$sample <- "SRR11647649"
s3$sample <- "SRR11647658"; s4$sample <- "SRR11647659"
all_samples <- rbind(s1, s2, s3, s4)

ggplot(all_samples, aes(x=coverage, fill=sample)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth=1, position="identity", alpha=0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=sample_colors) +
  xlim(0, 50) +
  labs(title="Coverage Distribution per CpG",
       x="Coverage (reads per CpG)", y="Number of CpGs") +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~sample, ncol=2)
ggsave("coverage_distribution.png", width=12, height=8)

# ============================================================
# 3. PEARSON CORRELATION
# ============================================================
merged <- Reduce(function(x,y) merge(x, y, by=c("chr","start","end")),
                 list(s1[,c("chr","start","end","methylation")],
                      s2[,c("chr","start","end","methylation")],
                      s3[,c("chr","start","end","methylation")],
                      s4[,c("chr","start","end","methylation")]))
colnames(merged) <- c("chr","start","end","SRR11647648","SRR11647649","SRR11647658","SRR11647659")

cor_matrix <- cor(merged[,4:7], method="pearson")

png("correlation_plot.png", width=800, height=800)
corrplot(cor_matrix, method="color", type="upper",
         addCoef.col="black", tl.col="black",
         col=colorRampPalette(c("#e89eb8","white","#332932"))(200),
         title="Pearson Correlation of Methylation Levels")
dev.off()

# ============================================================
# 4. PCA
# ============================================================
meth_matrix <- t(merged[,4:7])
meth_matrix <- meth_matrix[, apply(meth_matrix, 2, var) > 0]
pca <- prcomp(meth_matrix, scale=TRUE)

pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca$x[,1],
  PC2 = pca$x[,2],
  sample = rownames(pca$x),
  condition = c("normal", "normal", "tumor", "tumor")
)

var_explained <- round(summary(pca)$importance[2,] * 100, 1)

ggplot(pca_df, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=condition, label=sample)) +
  geom_point(size=5) +
  geom_text(vjust=-1, size=3) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("normal"="#e89eb8", "tumor"="#332932")) +
  labs(title="PCA of Methylation Levels",
       x=paste0("PC1 (", var_explained[1], "%)"),
       y=paste0("PC2 (", var_explained[2], "%)")) +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("pca_plot.png", width=8, height=6)

```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 5. PCA WITH DIFFERENT COVERAGE FILTERS
# ============================================================

# Merge coverage from all samples
cov <- Reduce(function(x,y) merge(x, y, by=c("chr","start","end")),
              list(s1[,c("chr","start","end","coverage")],
                   s2[,c("chr","start","end","coverage")],
                   s3[,c("chr","start","end","coverage")],
                   s4[,c("chr","start","end","coverage")]))
colnames(cov) <- c("chr","start","end","cov1","cov2","cov3","cov4")

run_pca <- function(min_coverage) {
  keep <- cov$cov1 >= min_coverage &
          cov$cov2 >= min_coverage &
          cov$cov3 >= min_coverage &
          cov$cov4 >= min_coverage
  
  merged_filtered <- merged[keep,]
  
  meth_matrix <- t(merged_filtered[,4:7])
  meth_matrix <- meth_matrix[, apply(meth_matrix, 2, var) > 0]
  pca <- prcomp(meth_matrix, scale=TRUE)
  
  pca_df <- data.frame(
    PC1 = pca$x[,1],
    PC2 = pca$x[,2],
    sample = rownames(pca$x),
    condition = c("normal", "normal", "tumor", "tumor"),
    filter = paste0(">=", min_coverage, "x\n(", nrow(merged_filtered), " CpGs)")
  )
  return(pca_df)
}

# Run for each filter
all_pca <- rbind(
  run_pca(5),
  run_pca(15),
  run_pca(20)
)

# Plot
ggplot(all_pca, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=condition, label=sample)) +
  geom_point(size=5) +
  geom_text(vjust=-1, size=3) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("normal"="#e89eb8", "tumor"="#332932")) +
  facet_wrap(~filter, ncol=3) +
  labs(title="PCA with Different Coverage Filters") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("pca_filtered.png", width=16, height=5)
```

```{r}
# Mean coverage per sample
mean_cov <- data.frame(
  sample = c("SRR11647648", "SRR11647649", "SRR11647658", "SRR11647659"),
  condition = c("normal", "normal", "tumor", "tumor"),
  mean_coverage = c(mean(s1$coverage), mean(s2$coverage), 
                    mean(s3$coverage), mean(s4$coverage))
)

ggplot(mean_cov, aes(x=sample, y=mean_coverage, fill=sample)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=mean(mean_cov$mean_coverage), 
             color="red", linetype="dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=sample_colors) +
  labs(title="Mean Coverage per Sample",
       x="Sample", y="Mean Coverage (reads)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))

ggsave("mean_coverage.png", width=8, height=6)
```
